# Synthetic migration fixture

`omaclipsync-0.2.0.state` was generated by compiling **unchanged** `core/src/v1_state.rs` and `core/src/storage.rs` from `Infinifar/omaclipsync` commit `a8c330136886ad547dfadf386bb66901b3bbc45c` in a temporary Rust program.

It contains only public synthetic data: key `[0x42; 32]`, token `"11".repeat(32)`, the example.test server, fixed UUIDs, an attempted upload containing `fixture only: 中文 😀`, and the queued `last offline copy`. No installed-client data, real key, user clipboard, or device credential was read.

The regression test verifies backward compatibility with the original AES-256-GCM envelope, appended newline, JSON schema, base64 text, and attempted/queued state. Do not regenerate this fixture with the new codec; that would remove its independent migration value.
